summary.text: Linda Hunt is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 17 who took office in November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as including work as a bus person, food server and realtor.

paragraphs.text: Hunt assumed office on November 6, 2024, succeeding Clara Thomas, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Education, Government Affairs, and Health and Human Services committees.
